mapper.select: SELECT * FROM expense_archive WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{report} AND round_no=#{round}
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_archive SET issue=#{issue},settlement_version=#{version},checked_at=#{checkedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_id=#{businessId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND archived_at IS NULL

UPDATE expense_archive SET issue=NULL,settlement_version=#{version},checked_at=#{at},archived_at=#{archivedAt},manifest_json=#{encoded},manifest_sha256=#{digest} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND report_id=#{businessId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND archived_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_archive_original(tenant_id,report_id,round_no,original_id) SELECT tenant_id,#{businessId},#{roundNo},id FROM invoice_original WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND invoice_id=#{invoiceId} AND owner_id=#{employeeId} AND sha256=#{sha256} AND status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT s.tenant_id,s.report_id,s.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM expense_settlement s LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND business.id=s.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=s.round_no WHERE s.status='SETTLED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM expense_archive a WHERE a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.report_id=s.report_id AND a.round_no=s.round_no AND a.archived_at IS NOT NULL) AND (s.tenant_id>#{argument1} OR (s.tenant_id=#{argument2} AND s.report_id>#{argument3})) ORDER BY s.tenant_id,s.report_id LIMIT 10
